name: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips
label: Quest
description: I've Got A Fever For More Bone Chips: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, it is true. My brother is a human. Shameful... A stain upon my nearly immaculate record.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It would be easier if they just accepted their illness and gave in to your healing touch. It would also probably be less fun. Carry on! We'll cure them, one way or another.
